user_query: I'm feeling bored and I need something to cheer me up. Can you provide me with a random meme that will make me laugh? Also, share some interesting facts about cats and recommend a novel that will lift my spirits.

TaskList.description: Fetch a random meme from an online meme generator.
Retrieve interesting facts about cats from a knowledge database.
Recommend a novel known for its uplifting themes from a book database.
